lines: Step lightly on the dock. Loose boards like to announce strangers.
Give the dock room. Fishing works better without elbows in it.
Step carefully near the dock. I would rather greet you than patch you up.
There you are. I was just near the dock, trying to keep the day sensible.
Watch your step. The dock is slick and proud of it.
Hello. If you came for fish, lower your voice.
You caught me before the line did.
Mind the net. It catches ankles when the fish refuse.
Morning. The water is pretending to be calm.
I have a moment while the river ignores me.
Stand there, unless you trust your balance more than I do.
Good to see someone dry for a change.
The boat is tied, the line is set, and I can talk.
If this is urgent, say so before the bobber moves.
Hello. Do not lean on that barrel unless you want a story.
The wind is carrying half my patience away today.
Come closer, but leave the net alone.
I was counting hooks. I can start again after you speak.
You have my ear until the water steals it.
